en.title: FAMILY BUSINESS (ARABIC)
en.subtitle: ENGLISH
en.synopsis: A poor family struggles to survive through small acts of theft, while the father dreams of a better life for his children. After an incident that nearly lands him in prison, he decides to abandon crime, only to realize that reality offers them no real opportunities. He then comes up with a different plan: instead of stealing money, each member of the family secretly secures a job inside the home of an extremely wealthy family, without anyone knowing they are related. Living under the same roof as strangers, they constantly face the stark contrast between their world and the world of their employers. As tension rises alongside moments of dark comedy, a major event threatens to expose everything, leaving everyone with a difficult question: can a happy ending truly be built on deception?

Thai Soi is a registered Thai food brand offering authentic Thai-inspired cuisine with a menu featuring classic and contemporary dishes crafted to deliver bold flavours and a vibrant dining experience.

Wingstop is an American international fast-casual restaurant brand specializing in hand-cooked chicken wings and bold, distinctive flavors, offering classic and boneless wings, tenders, sandwiches and seasoned sides. Gong Cha is a global bubble tea and specialty beverage brand known for its premium freshly brewed teas, customizable drinks with toppings like pearls and signature milk foam, crafted with quality ingredients and innovative flavor combinations.

Zafran Indian Kitchen is an award-winning contemporary Indian restaurant concept specializing in authentic North-West Frontier cuisine with rich, robust flavors. Founded in the UAE and expanded to Saudi Arabia, Zafran offers a distinctive dining experience with sought-after Indian classics like biryanis, curries, and signature dishes in a refined, warm setting.

Cold Stone Creamery is an American international ice cream parlor chain known for premium ice cream made fresh in stores and customized with mix-ins on a frozen granite stone. Doka Bakery & Restaurant offers a delightful blend of freshly baked goods, artisanal pastries, and delicious restaurant-style meals, crafted with high-quality ingredients for an unforgettable dining experience.

Tim Hortons is a popular Canadian chain known for its signature premium-blend coffee, alongside a selection of light fare, freshly baked pastries, and delicious breakfast sandwiches. With a cozy atmosphere and fast, friendly service, it’s the perfect spot to enjoy quality coffee and a quick bite throughout the day.

Herfy is a Saudi Arabian multinational fast food restaurant chain in Saudi Arabia and one of the largest in the Middle East, surpassing international chains in terms of presence. It has a total of more than 380 restaurants and 5,000 employees throughout Saudi Arabia.
The company has many subsidiaries including Herfy Bakery.

Founded in Seattle in 1985 and now based in Atlanta, Cinnabon is the market leader among cinnamon roll bakeries. The company serves fresh, aromatic, oven-hot cinnamon rolls, as well as a variety of other baked goods and speciality beverages. As of March 26, 2023 Cinnabon had more than 1,850 locations worldwide, primarily in high traffic venues such as shopping malls, airports, train stations, travel plazas, entertainment centres.

Sushi Library is a family-friendly casual Japanese restaurant brand offering a wide range of fresh sushi and Japanese-inspired dishes for all tastes and budgets. The menu is designed for both sushi beginners and enthusiasts, providing a vibrant dining experience with creative flavors and an inviting atmosphere that celebrates sharing food and culinary adventure

Jamie’s Italian is a globally recognized casual-dining restaurant brand founded by chef Jamie Oliver, celebrating authentic Italian cuisine with freshly sourced ingredients, handmade pasta, vibrant antipasti, and warm hospitality that brings people together.
Sweet Moon offers a world of imported and unique sweets, specializing in a wide selection of jelly-based candies in various shapes and flavors that delight candy lovers.

Mumuso is a global lifestyle brand offering a wide range of affordable, high-quality daily goods inspired by contemporary design, including beauty, personal care, fashion accessories, home essentials, electronics, stationery, and children’s products, aimed at enriching everyday life with stylish and functional items

brands.company_name_en: Danube for Food stuff and commodities LTD CO

Founded in 1987, Danube has grown under the BinDawood Holding umbrella to operate multiple stores across the Kingdom, offering quality products with a focus on customer service and convenience.

Huawei is a leading global technology company committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. The brand develops and provides innovative telecommunications infrastructure, smart devices, and consumer electronics that blend cutting-edge technology with quality and reliability.

DeFacto is a Turkish fashion retailer that started in 2005 with a mission to bring fresh, high-quality, and original fashion designs to consumers worldwide. The brand offers a wide range of clothing for women, men, and children, focusing on accessible and comfortable everyday style. DeFacto has grown into a global fashion brand with more than 500 stores in over 100 countries, providing casual, trendy, and diverse apparel options for all ages.
